name: api test suite cannot collect: importing codx.junior hangs
description:
## Problem
The `pytest:api` suite cannot run ANY test right now, so no change in `api/` can be verified (card `42bdacee` is blocked on this).

Measured with the QA tools on the current working tree:

| probe | result |
|---|---|
| `qa_run_tests(suite="pytest:api", paths=["api/tests/chat/test_single_response_per_chat.py"], timeout=300)` | timed out 300 s, 0 tests |
| same + `extra_args=["tests/chat/test_single_response_per_chat.py","-q"]` | timed out 300 s, 0 tests |
| same + `--collect-only -q` on that single file, timeout 120 | timed out 120 s |
| `extra_args=["--version"]`, timeout 60 | 0.2 s → interpreter + pytest + plugins start fine |

Conclusion: the interpreter is fine and the hang is NOT inside the tests — it happens while COLLECTING, i.e. while importing `codx.junior.api.chat` (and its chain: `codx.junior.engine`, `chat_engine`, `chat.turn_store`, `security.user_management`, `planning_manager`). `--collect-only` never prints a single test id.

## What to find
Which import blocks. Candidates worth checking first:
- `codx.junior.db` / settings opening a store or a network connection at import time,
- `codx.junior.context` ↔ `codx.junior.engine` circular import that waits on a lock (the test file already carries an import-order hack for it),
- a module-level call that takes a `flock` held by the running API process (same `.codx` data dir),
- module-level project discovery (`find_all_projects`) scanning slow mounts.

Reproduce with a bounded probe, e.g.:
`api/.venv/bin/python -X importtime -c "import codx.junior.api.chat"` (should return in seconds) and
`cd api && timeout 60 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/chat/test_single_response_per_chat.py --collect-only -q`.

## Acceptance
- `cd api && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/chat/test_single_response_per_chat.py -q` collects and finishes in well under 60 s.
- `qa_run_tests(suite="pytest:api", paths=["api/tests/chat/test_single_response_per_chat.py"])` returns a real verdict (passed/failed counts, no timeout).
- No import side effect at module load: importing a `codx.junior` module must not open a store, a socket or a project scan.

## Why it matters
Without a runnable suite the "always validate before releasing" contract of the agile/max harness cannot be honoured, and every `qa_review_changes` blocks with `tests.timeout`.
